passage.title: Carbohydrates
lines: Carbohydrates, which are sugars, are a vital part of
a healthy diet. They supply the main source of energy
for the body and also function to flavor and
sweeten foods. Carbohydrates range from simple sugars
such as glucose to complex sugars such as amylose and
amylopectin. Nutritionists estimate that carbohydrates
should make up about one-fourth to one-fifth of a
person's diet, which comes to about 75-100 grams of
carbohydrates per day.
A diet that is deficient in carbohydrates can seriously
harm a person's health. When the body
lacks enough carbohydrates, it must then
burn its protein supplies for energy, a process called
gluconeogenesis. However, this results in a lack of
necessary protein, and further health problems may
follow. A lack of carbohydrates can also lead to ketosis,
a build-up of ketones in the body that causes fatigue,
lethargy, and bad breath.

questions.text: The word "function" as used in line 3 refers to which of the following?
questions.explanation: 'function to flavor' = berfungsi untuk memberi rasa.
hints: Lihat konteks kalimat. Pilih arti yang cocok di kalimat itu.
Apa tugas karbohidrat terhadap makanan?
Jawaban B. 'function to flavor' = berfungsi untuk memberi rasa.
